hints.title: Graph Conversion
hints.text: Convert the tree into an undirected graph representation where each node connects to its left child, right child, and parent.

hints.title: Breadth-First Exploration
hints.text: Use a queue initialized with the starting infected node to simulate infection spreading outward minute by minute.

hints.title: Distance Tracking
hints.text: Track visited node values and compute the maximum level or distance reached before the queue becomes empty.

hints.title: Tree Infection Simulation Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Linear tree traversal to build adjacency list followed by queue traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-searching for parents repeatedly leads to quadratic time overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency list stores bidirectional connections for O(1) neighbor lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Converts binary tree to adjacency list or computes subtree heights relative to infected start node.
